## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (domain and use cases at minimum)
- [ ] Feature file in `features/` updated, if a feature is affected
- [ ] Translations complete in both `fr.json` and `en.json`, if UI text changed
- [ ] Works on macOS, Windows and Linux (no OS-specific paths or commands)
- [ ] No new dependency, or it was discussed in an issue first
- [ ] No real session data, personal data or secrets committed
